kaps_punt: Ligging van die Hoëveld, Laeveld, Groot Karoo, Klein Karoo, Kalahari en Namakwaland

items.bewering: 'n Streek is 'n groot gebied waar die landskap en die klimaat op die meeste plekke eenders is.
items.bron: Penn State GEOG 571, '1.7 Region Defined' (courses.ems.psu.edu/geog571/node/512), quoting Merriam-Webster: 'a broad geographic area distinguished by similar features'; physical regions are defined by shared landforms, vegetation and climate.

items.bewering: Die land verander as jy deur Suid-Afrika reis.
items.bron: Follows from the regional contrasts confirmed below (Highveld grassland at 1 500-2 100 m vs Lowveld at 200-600 m vs arid Karoo, Kalahari and Namaqualand): Wikipedia 'Highveld', 'Veld', Britannica 'Kalahari Desert', Britannica 'Karoo'.

items.bewering: Die Hoëveld is die hoë deel van die binnelandse plato.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Highveld': the portion of the South African inland plateau above roughly 1 500 m and below 2 100 m.

items.bewering: Dit lê veral in Gauteng en die Vrystaat en in dele van Mpumalanga en Noordwes.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Highveld' and 'Rand Highveld Grassland' / 'Eastern Highveld Grassland': Highveld grassland spans the Free State, Gauteng, Mpumalanga and North West; Gauteng lies within the Highveld.

items.bewering: Die land is redelik gelyk en het wye grasvlaktes.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Highveld' (plateau, mostly flat to gently rolling, Grassland Biome); Botanical Society of SA, 'Reflections of spring on the Highveld plateau'.

items.bewering: Die winters is koud, en ryp kom gereeld voor.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Highveld': summers wet, winters cold and dry, frost common in winter; EBSCO Research Starters 'Highveld grasslands': hard frosts June-August; frost and fire maintain the open grassland.

items.bewering: Die Laeveld is laer land onder die eskarp in Mpumalanga en Limpopo.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Highveld': the plateau escarpment separates the Highveld from the Mpumalanga Lowveld; Wikipedia 'Veld': Lowveld at roughly 200-600 m, lying in Limpopo and Mpumalanga. (Some sources also extend the term to northern KwaZulu-Natal; the lesson's statement is still true as written.)

items.bewering: Hier groei bosveld met bome en struike tussen die gras.
items.bron: Plants of Southern Africa / SANBI extract of Low & Rebelo (1996), Savanna Biome (pza.sanbi.org/node/11260): bushveld is savanna with a woody layer of trees and shrubs over a grass layer; Wikipedia 'Veld' places the Lowveld in the savanna/bushveld.

items.bewering: Die winters is sag en droog, en ryp kom selde voor.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Veld': subtropical, hot humid summers and mild dry winters; FAO Grassland Profile (fao.org/4/y5744e/y5744e05.htm): frost-free areas exist in the lowveld of South Africa.

items.bewering: Hulle is baie warmer as die winters op die Hoëveld.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Veld' (Lowveld significantly warmer than the Highveld); SAWS-based forecasts July 2026 (gauteng.net, snowreport.co.za): Johannesburg morning frost while Mbombela minimum 5-6 °C, maximum 21 °C, no frost.

items.bewering: Die Groot-Karoo is 'n groot en droë gebied in die binneland.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Great Karoo': a semi-desert inland plateau region; about 100-400 mm rain a year.

items.bewering: Dit strek oor dele van die Wes-Kaap, Noord-Kaap en Oos-Kaap.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Great Karoo' (stretches across the Western Cape, Northern Cape and Eastern Cape); Britannica 'Karoo'; SANBI/ecological sources: Nama Karoo on the central plateau of the Western, Northern and Eastern Cape.

items.bewering: Dit is 'n halfwoestyn: dit reën min, maar lae bossies kan hier groei.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Great Karoo' (semi-desert); WWF/One Earth 'Nama Karoo Shrublands': arid region dominated by low-shrub vegetation; SANParks Camdeboo vegetation page: karoo bushes.

items.bewering: Die Klein-Karoo is kleiner as die Groot-Karoo en lê in die Wes-Kaap.
items.bron: Britannica 'Little Karoo' and SA History Online 'Klein Karoo': a valley about 290-350 km long and 40-60 km wide in the Western Cape, separated from the much larger Great Karoo by the Swartberg.

items.bewering: Dit is ook droog en lê tussen bergreekse aan sy noordekant en sy suidekant.
items.bron: Britannica 'Little Karoo': between the Swartberg to the north and the Langeberg and Outeniqua mountains to the south; rainfall about 130 mm in the valleys to 400 mm in the mountains.

items.bewering: Die Kalahari is 'n droë gebied met rooi sand en sandduine.
items.bron: Britannica 'Kalahari Desert': in many areas the sand is red from a thin iron-oxide coating; long dune chains dominate the west; SANParks Kgalagadi: sparsely vegetated red dunes, mean annual rain about 120-350 mm.

items.bewering: In Suid-Afrika lê dit veral in die Noord-Kaap. Dit strek tot in Botswana en Namibië.
items.bron: Britannica 'Kalahari Desert': occupies almost all of Botswana, the eastern third of Namibia and the northernmost part of the Northern Cape; Springer chapter 'Dunes of the Southern Kalahari': the dunefield extends into the Northern Cape and south-eastern Namibia.

items.bewering: Namakwaland lê in die noordweste van Suid-Afrika in die Noord-Kaap.
items.bron: SANParks, Namaqua National Park news (Northern Cape); Desmet & Cowling / 'Namaqualand, South Africa – an overview of a unique winter-rainfall desert ecosystem' (the-eis.com).

items.bewering: Dit is droog, en die bietjie reën val meestal in die winter.
items.bron: 'Namaqualand, South Africa – an overview of a unique winter-rainfall desert ecosystem': a winter-rainfall desert, much of it under 150 mm a year; reliable winter rain explains the region's ecology.

items.bewering: In die lente ná die winterreën blom baie veldblomme in helder kleure.
items.bron: SANParks 'Namaqua National Park begins to bloom as wildflower season unfolds'; GroundUp 'Namaqualand flowers bloom after rainy winter'; the display peaks early August to early September and depends on the winter rains.

items.bewering: Die ses streke verskil dus in hoe hoog hulle lê en in hoe nat of droog hulle is.
items.bron: Altitudes: Highveld 1 500-2 100 m, Lowveld 200-600 m (Wikipedia 'Highveld', 'Veld'), Little Karoo valley around 300 m at Oudtshoorn (Britannica). Rainfall: Highveld 600-800 mm vs Namaqualand under 150 mm, Great Karoo 100-400 mm (sources as cited above).

items.bewering: Die Hoëveld en die Laeveld kry meer reën as die ander vier streke.
items.bron: Highveld about 600-800 mm (Wikipedia 'Highveld'); Lowveld about 400-750 mm across Kruger (Koedoe, Chirima et al. 2012) and about 680 mm at Mbombela; vs Great Karoo 100-400 mm (Wikipedia 'Great Karoo'), Little Karoo 130-400 mm (Britannica), South African Kalahari about 120-350 mm mean (SANParks Kgalagadi), Namaqualand under 150 mm. True as a regional comparison; only at the extreme edges (dry far-north Lowveld near Pafuri, about 416 mm; wetter north-eastern Kalahari fringe, up to about 450 mm) do the ranges touch, which does not make the regional statement false.

items.bewering: Die eskarp lê tussen die Hoëveld en die Laeveld.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Highveld' and 'Great Escarpment, Southern Africa': the plateau escarpment (Mpumalanga Drakensberg) separates the Highveld from the Mpumalanga Lowveld.

items.bewering: Botswana en Namibië word gewys waar die Kalahari oor die grens strek.
items.bron: Britannica 'Kalahari Desert' (Botswana, eastern Namibia, northern Northern Cape).

items.bewering: streek: 'n Groot gebied waar die landskap en die klimaat op die meeste plekke eenders is.
items.bron: Penn State GEOG 571 'Region Defined' / Merriam-Webster: a broad geographic area distinguished by similar features; physical regions share landforms, vegetation and climate.

items.bewering: binnelandse plato: Die wye, hoë en redelik gelyke land in Suid-Afrika se binneland.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Great Escarpment, Southern Africa' and 'Highveld': the central plateau of southern Africa, high and broadly level, bounded by the Great Escarpment.

items.bewering: eskarp: Die steil rand waar die plato na laer land toe afloop.
items.bron: Unisa GeoTerm 'escarpment' (gama.unisa.ac.za/geoterm/concepts/115/en); Wikipedia 'Great Escarpment, Southern Africa': the plateau edge drops sharply to the lower land.

items.bewering: Hoëveld: Die hoë deel van die binnelandse plato, met grasvlaktes en koue winters.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Highveld' (plateau above about 1 500 m, Grassland Biome, cold dry winters with frost).

items.bewering: Laeveld: Laer land onder die eskarp in Mpumalanga en Limpopo, met bosveld.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Veld' and 'Highveld'; SANBI Low & Rebelo Savanna Biome extract.

items.bewering: grasvlakte: Wye, redelik gelyke land waar meestal gras groei.
items.bron: Penn State GEOG 571 (the Great Plains as a physical region of flat grassland); Wikipedia 'Highveld' (plateau grassland).

items.bewering: bosveld: Veld waar bome en struike tussen die gras groei.
items.bron: Plants of Southern Africa / SANBI, Low & Rebelo (1996) Savanna Biome: bushveld is the intermediate woody-cover stage, trees and shrubs about 3-7 m over a grass layer.

items.bewering: halfwoestyn: 'n Baie droë gebied wat 'n bietjie meer reën as 'n woestyn kry.
items.bron: USGS 'Deserts: What is a desert?' (pubs.usgs.gov/gip/deserts/what), Meigs classification: arid lands under 250 mm a year, semi-arid 250-500 mm.

items.bewering: sandduin: 'n Heuwel van los sand wat die wind opgewaai het.
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries 'dune': a small hill of sand formed by the wind; Lumen Earth Science 'Dunes'. (Dunes can also form under water flow, but a desert sand dune such as the Kalahari's is wind-built, which is the sense used here.)

opsomming: Every claim in this lesson was checked and holds: the six regions are placed, described and compared correctly, there are no superlatives beyond the rainfall comparison (true as a regional statement), and nothing needs fixing.
